schemaNote: Local source-backed metadata; not an official Impeccable schema.
scope: Public landing page and Clerk entry presentation

direction.thesis: Study with purpose; remember with confidence.
direction.world: Silver-white and ice-blue reading surfaces, deep navy product and contrast sections, restrained clinical-blue accents, decorative brain/glass sculpture

effects: Desktop navigation becomes mobile menu; desktop returns at 1100px
Mode tabs become horizontal scrolling strip
Header account actions move into menu
Tablet loses perspective and becomes one column
System bars hide; recall estimate remains
Learning loop, science, practice cards, and final CTA stack

components.name: Hero
components.role: Headline, account creation, product demonstration and decorative sculpture

components.name: StudyPlanPreview
components.role: HTML tablet with explicitly illustrative recall estimate and study plan

components.name: ConceptLearning
components.role: Explicit two-prompt concept example and science disclosure

components.name: TrainingModesDock
components.role: Keyboard-selectable practice modes and associated panel

components.name: AuthDialog
components.role: Existing Clerk forms in Radix dialog

menu: Escape closes and restores toggle focus
tabs: Manual scrolling to keep selected narrow tab visible
auth: Trigger focus restoration with mobile-menu fallback
interaction.focusOutline: 3px solid accent, offset 4px; soft accent on dark surfaces

motion.entrance: 700ms translate from 10px to 0; content already visible

contentConstraints: Inference-first, concept-level review; no student confidence self-rating controls
Implicit binary Again/Good scheduling unchanged; no Hard/Easy ratings
Statistical confidence intervals do not currently drive scheduling; Wilson and shadow signals are separate and read-only
Fresh questions are the intended concept-review experience, not a universal never-repeat guarantee
Illustrative values must remain labelled and must not become learner-data fallbacks
No invented testimonials, adoption metrics, commercial terms, or validated learning outcomes
CTA opens account creation; no guaranteed assessment or payment offer

validation.basis: Source inspection and main finish-session verification reports

productionTypecheck.area: Existing AI-tracing and Prisma group-by errors outside landing changes

limitations: No phone, tablet, or desktop rendered visual pass
Real Clerk rendering, compact preview readability, focus presentation and sculpture composition need accessible-browser review
Science links and PANaCEa-specific learning outcomes are not independently validated by this design document
